headline: Rhode Island's End Measles Campaign
blurb: On January 23, 1966, a day named End Measles Sunday, more than 31,000 Rhode Island children ages 1 through 12 were vaccinated against measles during a snowstorm.

headline: Measles outbreak in Rhode Island.
blurb: Rhode Island counted 99 measles cases in late 1978 and early 1979, including 42 at one junior high school in East Providence.

headline: § 16-38-2. Immunization.
source: Rhode Island General Laws (Rhode Island General Assembly)
blurb: This Rhode Island law requires each student entering a public or private school to show proof of the vaccines set by the state health director, with exceptions for medical reasons and religious beliefs.

headline: Pertussis Alert
source: Rhode Island Department of Health (archived by the Internet Archive)
blurb: The Rhode Island Department of Health told health care providers that 50 whooping cough cases had been reported since January 2006, including 21 in August and September.

headline: Emerging Global Epidemiology of Measles and Public Health Response to Confirmed Case in Rhode Island
blurb: In April 2011, Rhode Island reported its first measles case since 1996, in a 28-year-old traveler who had flown in from Italy.

headline: Measles Case Identified in Rhode Island / Identifican caso de sarampión en Rhode Island
blurb: The Rhode Island Department of Health reported the state's first confirmed measles case since 2013, in a young unvaccinated child who had recently traveled internationally.
